product_brief: ML-KEM and ML-DSA library designed for secure SoC integration, supporting all security levels and protected against side-channel and fault injection attacks.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-KEM (FIPS 203) and ML-DSA (FIPS 204) algorithms at all security levels. Designed for secure SoC integration. Protected against side-channel and fault injection attacks.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SHA3-256, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256
fips_validated: Yes (Validated under CAVP; algorithms standardized in FIPS 203 and FIPS 204)
primary_platforms: Rocky Linux 8.10 (Green Obsidian) on AMD EPYC 7302 16-Core Processor
implementation_attack_surface: Protected against side-channel and fault injection attacks.
testing_&_validation_methods: Validated under Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP).

product_brief: Rust implementation of post-quantum cryptography algorithms with no_std support.
pqc_capability_description: Rust implementation of post-quantum cryptography algorithms with no_std support. Supports LMS (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen), and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer). Validated on Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 12) in ARM Cortex-A76.
crypto_primitives: LMS, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256
primary_platforms: Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 12) in ARM Cortex-A76
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Validated on ARM Cortex-A76; supports no_std.
